section: Important flagship programmes of the Central Government - social sector (health, education, nutrition, housing)
subsections: Health programmes → objective and launch year
Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC
ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose

accepted.s: With reference to Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, which one of the following is correct?
o: It provides ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation
It provides ₹1 lakh per family for outpatient treatment only
It provides ₹5 lakh per person per month for primary healthcare
It provides free LPG connections to poor households
accepted.x: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides health assurance of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its precise benefit and service level.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY was launched in:
accepted.x: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY was launched in September 2018.
accepted.tq: Use the exact launch year rather than confusing it with other health programmes.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Ayushman Arogya Mandir?
o: A digital platform for COVID-19 vaccination
A network of district critical-care blocks only
A scheme providing cash assistance for institutional delivery
A network of upgraded Health and Wellness Centres providing comprehensive primary care
accepted.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandir aims to provide comprehensive primary care through about 1.5 lakh upgraded Health and Wellness Centres.
accepted.tq: Distinguish primary-care infrastructure from insurance and digital-health schemes.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Ayushman Arogya Mandir was launched in:
accepted.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandir was launched in 2018.
accepted.tq: Separate close health-programme launch years.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following are components or objectives associated with PM-ABHIM?
1. District critical-care blocks
2. Integrated Public Health Laboratories
3. BSL-3 laboratories
4. Pandemic preparedness
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: PM-ABHIM covers district critical-care blocks, Integrated Public Health Laboratories, BSL-3 laboratories and pandemic preparedness.
accepted.tq: Test whether all listed functions belong to the same health-infrastructure mission.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The outlay of PM-ABHIM is ₹64,180 crore over a period of:
accepted.x: PM-ABHIM has an outlay of ₹64,180 crore over six years.
accepted.tq: Read the amount and duration as a combined quantitative fact.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mission Indradhanush primarily aims at:
o: Elimination of sickle cell anaemia by 2047
Full immunisation of children and pregnant women
Providing secondary and tertiary hospitalisation cover
accepted.x: Mission Indradhanush aims at full immunisation of children and pregnant women.
accepted.tq: Identify the target group and objective of an immunisation programme.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mission Indradhanush was launched in:
accepted.x: Mission Indradhanush was launched in December 2014.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the launch years of immunisation and maternal-health programmes.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Janani Suraksha Yojana:
1. It provides cash assistance for institutional delivery.
2. It is implemented under the National Health Mission.
3. It is a 100 per cent centrally sponsored scheme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Janani Suraksha Yojana provides cash assistance for institutional delivery under the NHM and is 100 per cent centrally sponsored.
accepted.tq: Verify objective, administrative location and funding pattern together.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission — full immunisation of pregnant women
accepted.x: Pulse Polio was launched for polio eradication. India was certified polio-free by WHO in 2014; the other pairs wrongly combine programmes and years or objectives.
accepted.tq: Match each programme with its distinctive objective before checking the year.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: India was certified polio-free by the World Health Organization in:
accepted.x: The World Health Organization certified India polio-free in 2014.
accepted.tq: Recall the certification year rather than the launch year of Pulse Polio.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission has the objective of eliminating sickle cell anaemia by:
accepted.x: The mission aims to eliminate sickle cell anaemia by 2047.
accepted.tq: Identify the long-term target year from the available dates.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission was launched at Shahdol in:
accepted.x: The mission was launched at Shahdol in Madhya Pradesh in July 2023.
accepted.tq: Use the location trap by distinguishing the launch place from other programme locations.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about Ayushman Bharat is correct?
o: It targets poor and vulnerable populations in both rural and urban areas.
It is restricted exclusively to government employees.
It targets only urban households above the poverty line.
It covers only pregnant women and children.
accepted.x: Ayushman Bharat targets poor and vulnerable populations in rural as well as urban areas.
accepted.tq: Reject the restrictive words ‘only’ and ‘exclusively’ in a target-group question.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As of March 2025, the number of Ayushman cards was approximately:
accepted.x: The number of Ayushman cards stood at 39.94 crore as of March 2025.
accepted.tq: Place the numerical figure correctly by checking its crore scale.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding PM-JAY beneficiaries is correct?
1. The scheme covers 6 crore senior citizens.
2. Women constitute 49 per cent of beneficiaries.
3. The scheme covers only senior citizens.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because PM-JAY is not restricted only to senior citizens.
accepted.tq: Find the restrictive false statement while retaining the two supported figures.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes the National Health Mission?
1. It has two parts: NRHM and NUHM.
2. ASHAs and ANMs form its backbone.
3. It consists only of the National Rural Health Mission.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because NHM includes both NRHM and NUHM.
accepted.tq: Spot the false ‘only’ statement in an institutional-composition question.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Infant Mortality Rate declined from 40 in 2013 to what figure in 2023?
accepted.x: The Infant Mortality Rate declined from 40 in 2013 to 25 in 2023.
accepted.tq: Track the exact beginning and ending values in a trend question.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Between 1990 and 2023, the Under-5 Mortality Rate and Neonatal Mortality Rate declined by, respectively:
accepted.x: Between 1990 and 2023, the Under-5 Mortality Rate declined by 78 per cent and the Neonatal Mortality Rate by 70 per cent.
accepted.tq: Avoid reversing the two percentages in a paired comparison.
accepted.sec: Health programmes → objective and launch year  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below.

List-I (Scheme)
a. PMAY-Urban
b. PMKVY
c. Ujjwala
 d. Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana

List-II (Objective)
i. Skill development for youth
ii. Affordable housing in cities
iii. Free LPG connections to BPL women
iv. Life and disability cover for rural landless households
accepted.x: PMAY-Urban concerns affordable urban housing, PMKVY skill development, Ujjwala LPG connections and Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana life and disability cover for rural landless households.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure housing and LPG pairs, then complete the code.
accepted.sec: Scheme → objective and launch year (matching)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following schemes was launched at Ballia in 2016?
accepted.x: The Ujjwala scheme, providing free LPG connections to BPL women, was launched at Ballia in 2016.
accepted.tq: Combine the launch place, year and distinctive benefit.
accepted.sec: Scheme → objective and launch year (matching)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana is run through:
accepted.x: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana, which provides life and disability cover for rural landless households, is run through LIC.
accepted.tq: Identify the implementing agency rather than the scheme’s target group.
accepted.sec: Scheme → objective and launch year (matching)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the food-grain schemes is correct?
1. PMGKAY was launched during the COVID-19 period.
2. Free NFSA grains under PMGKAY were provided for five years from 1 January 2024.
3. Annapurna provides 10 kg of free food grains per month to eligible needy seniors not receiving an old-age pension.
4. Antyodaya Anna Yojana provides 35 kg per family per month to the poorest households.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. PMGKAY relates to the COVID-19 period and the subsequent five-year NFSA grain provision, while Annapurna and Antyodaya have the stated entitlements.
accepted.tq: Check each scheme against its launch context, period and quantity entitlement.
accepted.sec: Scheme → objective and launch year (matching)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Operation Blackboard was launched in 1987 under the National Policy on Education, 1986, with the objective of providing:
o: Loans for students in top-quality higher educational institutions
Free MOOCs from Class 9 to postgraduate level
accepted.x: Operation Blackboard was launched to provide minimum facilities in primary schools, particularly in educationally backward areas.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an older primary-school infrastructure programme from newer digital and higher-education schemes.
accepted.sec: Education programmes → objective  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which programme provides free massive open online courses from Class 9 to the postgraduate level?
accepted.x: SWAYAM provides free MOOCs from Class 9 to the postgraduate level.
accepted.tq: Match the digital education platform with its learner range.
accepted.sec: Education programmes → objective  [APPSC]

accepted.s: PM-Vidyalaxmi is associated with:
o: Upgrading primary schools in educationally backward areas
Foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 3
Collateral-free and guarantor-free loans for students admitted to top-quality HEIs
accepted.x: PM-Vidyalaxmi provides collateral-free and guarantor-free loans to students admitted to top-quality higher educational institutions.
accepted.tq: Separate a higher-education finance scheme from school-improvement programmes.
accepted.sec: Education programmes → objective  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Samagra Shiksha covers which range of education?
accepted.x: Samagra Shiksha covers education from pre-school to Class 12 and merged SSA, RMSA and Teacher Education.
accepted.tq: Use the span of coverage to distinguish integrated school education from specialised schemes.
accepted.sec: Education programmes → objective  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly matches an education programme with its objective?
o: PM SHRI — upgrades more than 14,500 schools as NEP 2020 model schools
NIPUN Bharat — provides free LPG connections
DIKSHA — provides cash assistance for institutional delivery
SWAYAM — supplies 35 kg food grains per family
accepted.x: PM SHRI upgrades more than 14,500 schools as model schools under NEP 2020. The other options wrongly attach non-educational objectives to education programmes.
accepted.tq: Use the programme’s name and sector to reject cross-sector substitutions.
accepted.sec: Education programmes → objective  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NIPUN Bharat aims to achieve foundational literacy and numeracy by:
accepted.x: NIPUN Bharat aims to achieve foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 3.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact grade milestone rather than a broad school stage.
accepted.sec: Education programmes → objective  [APPSC]

accepted.s: DIKSHA is best described as:
o: A national digital platform for teachers and school content
accepted.x: DIKSHA is the national digital platform for teachers and school content.
accepted.tq: Distinguish education technology platforms from health and food-security platforms.
accepted.sec: Education programmes → objective  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the National Food Security Act, 2013, coverage may extend up to:
o: 75% of the rural population and 50% of the urban population
100% of both rural and urban populations
25% of the rural population and 25% of the urban population
50% of the rural population and 75% of the urban population
accepted.x: NFSA 2013 covers up to 75 per cent of the rural population and 50 per cent of the urban population.
accepted.tq: Avoid reversing the rural and urban coverage percentages.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly states the NFSA food-grain entitlement?
1. Priority households receive 5 kg per person per month.
2. AAY households receive 35 kg per household per month.
3. Both categories receive an identical per-person entitlement.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because priority households have a per-person entitlement while AAY has a per-household entitlement.
accepted.tq: Distinguish per-person and per-household quantities.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under NFSA, the eldest woman who is at least 18 years of age is designated as the:
o: Beneficiary representative of the urban local body
Nodal officer for the fair-price shop
Chairperson of the district food authority
Head of the household on the ration card
accepted.x: The eldest woman aged 18 years or above is treated as the head of the household on the ration card.
accepted.tq: Recall the statutory household-identification rule without substituting an administrative office.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The maternity benefit provided under the National Food Security Act is:
accepted.x: NFSA provides a maternity benefit of ₹6,000.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact monetary entitlement from close-value options.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The nodal ministry for POSHAN Abhiyaan is the Ministry of:
accepted.x: The Ministry of Women and Child Development is the nodal ministry for POSHAN Abhiyaan.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who would do this job?’ method to identify the nodal ministry.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
POSHAN Abhiyaan brings together which of the following programmes or missions?
1. ICDS
2. National Health Mission
3. Swachh Bharat
4. PM-JAY
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: POSHAN Abhiyaan brings together ICDS, NHM and Swachh Bharat to address stunting, under-nutrition, anaemia and low birth weight. PM-JAY is not one of the listed convergent programmes.
accepted.tq: Identify the one programme wrongly inserted into a convergence list.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mission Poshan 2.0 focuses particularly on:
accepted.x: Mission Poshan 2.0 focuses on diet diversity, fortification and millets. It is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development during 2021-22 to 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Match the nutrition mission with its specific intervention areas.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s: One Nation One Ration Card primarily provides:
o: Portability of health insurance only within one district
Portability of NFSA ration benefits anywhere in India
Inter-State transfer of LPG subsidies only
accepted.x: One Nation One Ration Card enables NFSA beneficiaries to access ration benefits anywhere in India.
accepted.tq: Apply the portability concept to a migrant beneficiary scenario.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The national rollout of One Nation One Ration Card began in:
accepted.x: The national rollout of One Nation One Ration Card began in 2019.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the rollout year from the year of enactment of NFSA.
accepted.sec: Food security and nutrition - NFSA, POSHAN, ONORC  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which platform provides a 14-digit identification number linking an individual’s health records?
accepted.x: ABHA provides a 14-digit Health ID that links an individual’s health records.
accepted.tq: Match the health IT platform with its identifier function.
accepted.sec: ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Healthcare Professionals Registry under ABDM is a registry of:
o: Pregnant women and children receiving immunisation
Doctors, nurses and other healthcare providers
Only TB patients notified by States
accepted.x: The Healthcare Professionals Registry contains doctors, nurses and other healthcare providers. ABDM also includes a Health Facility Registry and a Sandbox.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a professional registry from patient, facility and disease registries.
accepted.sec: ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: ABHA — registry of only healthcare professionals
accepted.x: CoWIN is the digital platform for COVID-19 vaccination. U-WIN concerns routine immunisation, eSanjeevani telemedicine and ABHA health records.
accepted.tq: Use elimination among similar-sounding digital health platforms.
accepted.sec: ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: U-WIN is a digital registry for routine immunisation of:
accepted.x: U-WIN is the digital registry for routine immunisation of pregnant women and children.
accepted.tq: Identify the beneficiary group rather than confusing U-WIN with CoWIN.
accepted.sec: ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: eSanjeevani is primarily associated with:
accepted.x: eSanjeevani is the national telemedicine platform, with a Clinical Decision Support System integrated into it.
accepted.tq: Match the platform with its service domain and reject cross-sector distractors.
accepted.sec: ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission was launched in 2021 and is implemented by the:
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
accepted.x: ABDM was launched in 2021 and is implemented by the National Health Authority.
accepted.tq: Separate the implementing authority from the ministries associated with nutrition and education.
accepted.sec: ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Arogya Mitra, in the context of government health programmes, is best described as:
o: A component of the ABDM Health Facility Registry
accepted.x: Arogya Mitra functions as a PM-JAY hospital facilitator; it is not an ABDM component.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between a PM-JAY facilitation role and ABDM digital components.
accepted.sec: ABDM and health IT platforms → purpose  [APPSC]
